children: Finnair shares are up a third since the Iran war, as Europe-Asia fliers connect in Helsinki instead of Dubai. Middle East disruption has also boosted cargo demand at the likes of €9 bln Lufthansa. But with Emirates and rivals rebuilding schedules, the boom’s longevity is foggy.
Full view will be published shortly.
The International Air Transport Association said on August 31 that global air passenger traffic grew 0.2% year-on-year in July. Excluding the Middle East, there was a 1.2% increase, IATA said.
The airline trade association added that passenger traffic between Europe and Asia grew 12.1%, representing the strongest expansion of any major international corridor.
